answer: Fraud-proof escrow locks one bond per paid claim until a challenge window ends. For an atlas update locating a grove, require authenticated survey data; an echo of the worker's own claim is not evidence. A valid public proof of a mismatch cancels payment and slashes that bond. N concurrent identities must lock N bonds, and abandoning accounts cannot release them early. This needs objective fraud proofs and an honest watcher; set the slash above potential fraud gains. Unverifiable tasks remain outside its scope.
